ValidationRule.description: When Is Insight Proposed has any option that starts with No, cannot be blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", RecordType.DeveloperName = "IME_Standard_Opportunity"),
ISBLANK( InSight_not_in_proposal_Explanation__c ),
(OR( INCLUDES(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c,"No - Using Hyland Software due to feature requirements"), INCLUDES(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c,"No - Using other IRM product"), INCLUDES(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c,"No - Price"), INCLUDES(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c,"No - Missing Feature"), INCLUDES(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c,"No - Customer has internal solution"), INCLUDES(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c,"No - Other"))), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Must fill out explanation as to why not included in Proposal.
